objective: Share one explicit-project MCP transport and preserve project handoffs across replacement ChatGPT chats
acceptance_criteria: Every scoped shared-mode tool requires a registered explicit project key
Project Agents, sessions, receipts and handoff revisions remain separate
A fresh MCP process resumes durable state without executing prior tasks
Stale or concurrent handoffs cannot overwrite newer revisions
Private Tunnel setup is backed up and contains only environment credential references
Actual web tool refresh and per-project read/receipt acceptance are recorded separately from local tests
